verdict.rationale: Make documents scenarios that run unattended: they can be scheduled, triggered by webhooks from external services, or set to process queued webhook data whenever schedule criteria are met. Error handlers, scenario history and an AI Agents app (open-beta API) support autonomous agentic runs. Missing for 10: detailed docs on scheduling options and background-run monitoring (current evidence is only thin snippets), GA status for AI Agents (currently open beta), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
